name: Transcorp Plc
source: CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column added from Transnational Corporation Plc unaudited consolidated and separate financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026, filed on the Nigerian Exchange and published by the issuer (transcorpgroup.com, Quarter 2 2026 financial statements, July 2026), consolidated statement of profit or loss, group column, printed in thousands of naira and stored here as absolute naira: Revenue 241,529,759; cost of sales 131,786,537; gross profit 109,743,222; other income 657,746; impairment reversal on financial assets 1,961,934; administrative expenses 30,812,108; operating profit 81,550,794; finance income 2,108,113; finance cost 6,410,929; foreign exchange loss on financing activities 1,363,779; profit before taxation 75,884,199; taxation 21,517,430; profit for the period 54,366,769 (attributable to owners of the parent 32,855,212, non-controlling interests 21,511,557). Gates tie exactly: 241,529,759 less 131,786,537 equals 109,743,222; gross profit plus other income plus the impairment reversal less administrative expenses equals the printed operating profit 81,550,794; operating profit less net finance costs of 5,666,595 equals the printed profit before taxation; 75,884,199 less 21,517,430 equals 54,366,769. Operating Expenses is administrative expenses less other income less the impairment reversal, so gross profit less operating expenses reproduces the printed operating profit; Net Finance Costs is the net finance cost (finance cost 6,410,929 less finance income 2,108,113) plus the foreign exchange loss on financing of 1,363,779, so operating profit less net finance costs reproduces the printed profit before taxation. EPS is the printed basic earnings per share of 323 kobo, stored in naira as 3.23. Gross, operating and net margin are computed from this column. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty for H1 2026 because no H1 2026 balance sheet inputs were read into those rows in this pass. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | TRANSCORP group income tax corrected to the printed P&L charge for FY2025-FY2021 (see row source); group EPS corrected for FY2025/FY2024. Unit NGN. | FY2023/FY2022 cost of sales, gross profit, EBIT and net finance costs filled from the audited 2023 annual report p.79 | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from Transnational Corporation Plc unaudited consolidated statement of profit or loss page 5, group 30 September 2026 column, with the earnings per share note on page 26, printed in thousands of naira and stored x1,000. Printed at that column: revenue 357,381,171; cost of sales -195,272,645; gross profit 162,108,526; other income 493,925 plus an impairment write-back of 11,700,735 less administrative expenses 48,737,958 (operating expenses) giving operating profit 125,565,228; finance income 4,057,218 and finance cost 15,123,666, a net finance cost of 11,066,448; a separate foreign exchange loss on financing activities of 3,112,276; profit before taxation 111,386,504; taxation 36,295,217; profit for the period 75,091,287; basic earnings per share 429 kobo, stored as 4.29 naira to match the EPS unit already in this file. Ties exactly: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; gross profit plus other income plus the impairment write-back less administrative expenses equals operating profit; operating profit less net finance costs less the foreign exchange loss equals profit before taxation; profit before taxation less taxation equals profit for the period; profit attributable to shareholders of 43,622,616 over 10,161,998 thousand shares reproduces the printed 429 kobo per share. | EPS 2025 and 2024 normalised from the audited kobo print (note 19, FY2025 annual report p101: 844 and 145 kobo) to naira, matching the row's other periods. | CRON 20261120_0502: 9M 2026 EPS None to 4.29 from the issuer Q3 2026 filing in the NGX doclib library (doclib.ngxgroup.com).

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged. Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed.
